coin.specsText:
Product details Wind power Energy of the future Alongside hydropower and solar energy, wind power is becoming the third pillar of Switzerland's energy supply: wind energy bridges the gap created by lower hydroelectric and solar energy production in winter. This is because wind power generates two thirds of its total production in winter. The combination of wind, solar and hydropower means we can all receive Swiss-sourced carbon-free electricity. "Wind power", is the last coin in the trilogy on the theme of "Energy of the future". - Coin image: Wind power – coin with colour and fluorescent elements - Legal face value: 20 Swiss francs - Date of issue: 27 September 2023 - Selling period: up to 26 September 2026 or while stocks last - Design: Benjamin Löbbert, Bern - Alloy: Silver 0,999 - Weight: 20 g - Diameter: 33 mm - Proof: 10,000 coins The 20-franc “Wind power” silver coin is not included in the subscription.
